conformance.only_blocking_items: Three documented provider OpenAPI path-template defects; see spec_defects. No request-body or parser failures. No live-account verification performed.

spec_defects.detail: Published collection path is /event/{type?}, with parameter named type (default normal). The pinned OpenAPI template names type? instead of type and overlaps /event/{guid}, so openapi-core validates /event/normal as a UUID lookup. Node sends the documented collection filter.

Published collection path is /location/{type?}, with parameter named type (default normal). The malformed optional template overlaps /location/{guid}; openapi-core validates /location/normal as a UUID lookup. Node sends the documented collection filter.

Published route is /event/:guid/ticket/{type?}. Pinned contract uses /event/{guid}/ticket/{type?} but declares type, not type?, and omits a guid parameter declaration. Node substitutes the event GUID and normal filter as documented; validator cannot resolve type.
